t: Meeting with Novgorod Region Governor Alexander Dronov
d: The Governor of the Novgorod Region briefed the President on the region’s socioeconomic development.

kb.svo: …also outlined the measures in place to support participants in the special military operation and their families. A social coordinator is assigned to each family.…

t: Greetings to participants and guests of High Technology Championship finals
d: Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to the participants and guests of the High Technology Championship finals, which kicked off in Veliky Novgorod.
